name: thinking-ko
description: Shows Claude's thinking (as a quote above the reply it led to) and replies in casual Korean; display only, the transcript is unchanged. Claude Haiku by default, Gemini with your own key.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key (optional)
gemini_api_key.description: Leave empty to translate with Claude Haiku. When set, replies are translated with the Gemini API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com) using this key.

gemini_model.title: Gemini model
gemini_model.description: Gemini model used when a key is set.

claude_model.title: Claude model
claude_model.description: Claude model alias or id used when no Gemini key is set.
